# truenas_cloudsync_run (Action)

Runs a cloud sync task now (cloudsync.sync).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Trigger an on-demand run of a cloud sync task (Terraform 1.14+).
action "truenas_cloudsync_run" "example" {
  config {
    id = 1
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Cloud sync task id (truenas_cloudsync.<name>.id).
